study.question: Does the small validation gain from permuted-label auxiliary supervision come from deterministic batch-prevalence calibration, from auxiliary-logit dispersion suppression, or require stochastic misaligned-label gradients?
study.hypothesis: Observed, not repeated: static/pooled/DIN validation AUCs are 0.6050036145/0.6102261137/0.6133619861. Aligned history auxiliary AUC 0.6129014321 is lower by 0.0004605540; detached exactly matches DIN; permuted improves by only 0.0001287969 to 0.6134907830 (Logloss 0.1966424215 versus 0.1967946465); target-only reaches 0.6134556006. Thus evidence does not support beneficial history-specific click supervision. Candidate diagnostics report attention entropy 3.59916 for permuted versus 3.29882 detached and 3.43176 aligned on only the first 512 validation rows; they are descriptive, candidate-supplied and not causal. Exploratory slices are mixed: permuted AUC 0.57344296 versus DIN 0.57457022 for length 1-16, 0.59243803 versus 0.59187171 for length 17-64, and 0.61446869 versus 0.61442035 for length >64. Corresponding fixed slice counts (samples/positive/negative) are 41805/1444/40361, 157391/6311/151080, and 3026583/151372/2875211; empty history is 8272/310/7962. No slice was selected as a success criterion. Provisional mechanism: marginal prediction regularization, rather than correct per-example click targets, may explain the permuted trajectory. For auxiliary logits z on nonempty rows, q=mean(current training labels), m=mean(z), define M=softplus(m)-q*m and D=mean(softplus(z))-softplus(m). M+D equals mean BCE(z,q), exactly the conditional expectation over uniform within-batch label permutations. Testing deterministic M+D removes auxiliary label-sampling noise; toggling M,D separately examines which component matters. This equality holds for fixed logits/labels; it does not equate SGD trajectories or prove generalization. No overfitting curve or independent history probe is available.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the local activation idea through the existing reference. Original DIN relaxes softmax normalization whereas this frozen local reference uses normalized attention; it is not an exact DIN reproduction. DIN section 5.1 regularizes active sparse embedding weights with frequency scaling; this candidate instead regularizes training-only auxiliary logits by exact expected shuffled BCE. No claim of being first to use soft targets, confidence penalties, or Jensen decompositions; registry searches for confidence/regularization returned no additional primary sources, so global novelty remains unverified.

Nearest implemented local method uses a private RNG to permute nonempty-row click labels. Keep backbone/head shapes, initialization and coefficient; replace sampled labels with the exact expected loss and factorial M/D removals. This is a follow-up attribution study, not a new architecture claim.

Author README confirms category, brand and behavior type without item identity. No item reconstruction or future-event target is invented. Publisher full text is unavailable in the authorized snapshot, so detailed DMR objective equivalence and priority are unresolved.

Source separates contextual transport from distillation and documents failed capacity/training directions. No transport, teacher or external soft label is adopted: q is derived exclusively from current training labels.

Source uses a different multi-domain input/architecture and discusses next-action delay labels. Those targets are not supplied here. No delay regression, bus, highway, refresh or source optimizer is introduced.

study.proposed_difference: Replace stochastic permuted-label auxiliary BCE by its deterministic conditional expectation. Register a 2x2 loss-component factorial: expected_permuted=(M=1,D=1), mean_only=(1,0), dispersion_only=(0,1), neither=(0,0). All execute the same auxiliary head and scalar calculations during training, keep 577 auxiliary parameters, and never execute that head in prediction. The neither arm has zero auxiliary gradients and should reproduce the existing DIN/detached reference. No new data, preprocessing, architecture, optimizer or training passes. At all-empty batches both terms are exactly masked to zero. Each module is standalone. Local checks passed: source compilation/AST and resolved study-schema validation, exact module CONFIG versus proposal checks, unchanged ancestor encoder AST, full 2x2 coverage, and exhaustive stdlib scalar expectation/finite-difference checks over 596 masked binary-label cases including empty/singleton and extreme logits. Torch is absent; no tensor execution, host training/scoring or candidate performance has been verified. Check commands: python3 -m json.tool proposal.json; syntax compilation can use compile(open(FILE).read(), FILE, "exec") for each registered file without importing torch. For experiment reproduction, submit these exact standalone files and their literal registered configs through the host interface under protocol 9c1635366a72f4c4f67708ee7ae9b72a1b90197ffed3485736388ceff7c91d3e; do not replace frozen host commands.
predictions: If deterministic marginal regularization suffices, expected_permuted should improve full-population validation AUC over neither and approach or exceed the exploratory historical 0.6134907830 permuted result; secondary unweighted Logloss should not materially worsen. A single-seed difference is preliminary, regardless of direction.

If dispersion suppression contributes, AUC(expected_permuted)-AUC(mean_only) and AUC(dispersion_only)-AUC(neither) should be positive with lower candidate-supplied auxiliary-logit variance/Jensen gap. Predeclare the two conditional effects and interaction, not whichever arm wins.

If mean calibration contributes, AUC(expected_permuted)-AUC(dispersion_only) and AUC(mean_only)-AUC(neither) should be positive. Neither should match baseline-din and g3-r0000-detached_aux under seed 42; a material mismatch triggers an implementation audit.

At most small extra training time relative to approximately 610 seconds per inherited full run; parameter count expected 17130852 versus DIN 17130275. All four inference operation graphs are identical to the inherited auxiliary implementation. Measured throughput/latency, allocated GPU seconds and memory, rather than operation-count equivalence, decide practical cost.

Predeclared AUC interaction is AUC(expected_permuted)-AUC(mean_only)-AUC(dispersion_only)+AUC(neither). Report all four cells and both conditional contrasts, including null/negative outcomes. Seed-42 screening alone cannot confirm this interaction.
falsifiers: Expected_permuted fails to improve over neither and no factorial component helps: no evidence for useful deterministic marginal regularization at weight 0.2; do not rebrand a null result as representation improvement.

Dispersion-only lowers auxiliary variance/Jensen gap without improving AUC, or mean-only accounts for the entire gain: reject a dispersion-driven generalization explanation for this configuration. Head collapse alone is not evidence of useful representations.

Mean-only fails both conditional contrasts while dispersion-only accounts for the gain: reject necessary batch-prevalence calibration. A strong interaction prevents an additive mechanism interpretation.

Historical shuffled-label gains disappear with deterministic targets: stochastic gradient effects, sample correlations, or seed/checkpoint variation remain live explanations. A paired re-execution of the archived shuffled source is then required before attributing this difference to noise.

Neither fails to reproduce reference metrics, nonfinite loss/logits appear, or host receipts reveal changed training coverage: comparisons are invalid until fixed within remaining budget; retain failed costs.
Any apparent gain fails seeds 43 and 44 or measured cost is unacceptable: retain preliminary/negative status; no confirmed contribution or equal-compute efficiency claim.
alternative_explanations: Head and representation co-adapt; low dispersion can result from head collapse rather than useful history representations.
Shared category/brand embeddings and target-conditioned attention allow gradients to affect static and target paths; this is not a history-exclusive intervention.
Only one seed in this proposal; differences near 0.0001 AUC can be seed or checkpoint noise.
Mean-only and dispersion-only arms naturally change head optimization and gradient magnitudes; fixed coefficients isolate loss components, not equal gradient norm.
Permuted labels preserve batch prevalence and can retain user/time correlations; their historical gain is not a controlled estimate of independent random-label regularization.
Batch q varies with training sampling; conditioning on q differs from a fixed global prior. No population prior is estimated from validation.
Jensen-gap magnitude depends on mean logit/sigmoid curvature, so gap-only is not a mean-independent variance penalty.
Embedding sharing and empty-history prediction changes can occur despite masking empty rows from the auxiliary loss. Validation exposure rows are correlated by user.

Only inherited best-checkpoint summaries and bounded diagnostics are available; no training curve demonstrates overfitting. Negative aligned supervision does not refute all representation-learning objectives.
